name: Book campaign - 5 emails (EN)
note: Written 2026-11-24. Every number here is checkable: prices and page counts on /books/, the 7-day Hotmart window on /refund-policy.html, the 48-hour Play window in Google's own policy. emails.subject: The next step after the guide
emails.preheader: Eight books in PDF from $4.99; the whole pack is $29.99
emails.body_html:
Hi,

You have the guide. The next step is not more free reading: it is picking one book and doing the field missions.

If you are starting from zero, the manual is Chaos Magick for Absolute Beginners: 176 pages, 20 chapters and a 15-minute field mission at the end of each. $9.99.

If you already practise, Codex Chaoticus is the general treatise and the usual first purchase: $4.99.

See the eight books

All eight together are $29.99 instead of $68.92. If you buy one and later want the pack, write to us and we will look at it.

Frater Alek0s

emails.subject: Which of the eight books is yours (and which is not)
emails.preheader: One decision per profile, not a list of ten
emails.body_html:
Hi,

Three doors, one decision:

  • Never cast a circle: Chaos Magick for Absolute Beginners. 176 pages, $9.99.
  • Already practising and want the system: Codex Chaoticus ($4.99) and, if you work with servitors, the 368-page treatise: $9.99.
  • The technical side: TECHNOMANCY. 399 pages, 45 chapters, six projects with code that runs. $9.99.

None of them promises a supernatural result. The longest treatise ships with seventeen contraindications and a section on what to do when nothing happens; that is part of the method too.

See which one fits

emails.subject: The pack: 8 books for $29.99, and what happens with the money
emails.preheader: The arithmetic of the pack and the 7-day window
emails.body_html:
Hi,

The English pack delivers eight books for $29.99. Bought one by one they add up to $68.92, so the difference is $38.93.

Two things worth knowing before paying:

  • Hotmart gives 7 days to request a refund. You do not have to justify it.
  • It is not a subscription: one payment and the files are yours.

See the pack

If $29.99 is a lot this month, Codex Chaoticus is $4.99 and it is where most people start.

Frater Alek0s

emails.subject: What the people who stay do after week one
emails.preheader: Seven days, one entry a night, and the coven
emails.body_html:
Hi,

The pattern that works is boring: seven days, ten minutes a day, one logged entry per night. Seven comparable entries beat seven impressions.

If you want the log already built, the seven-day protocol is free and asks for nothing.

And if you have done the first week, the natural home for the log is the coven: what the circle is.

The books, whenever you want them: eight titles from $4.99.

Frater Alek0s

emails.subject: Last email about this (and the only number that matters)
emails.preheader: If it is not the moment, it is not; the door stays open
emails.body_html:
Hi,

This is the last email in the series. If you have not bought, it is probably because it is not the moment, and that is a valid answer.

Two things that do not expire:

  • The 70 free tools stay where they are.
  • The eight books stay at $4.99-$9.99 and the pack at $29.99, with no countdown and no limited seats.

When you want to continue, write to us and we will tell you where to start.

Frater Alek0s
